      "source": [
        "\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "np.random.seed(42)\n",
        "\n",
        "n_cities = 20\n",
        "particles = 40\n",
        "iterations = 150\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "cities = np.random.rand(n_cities, 2) * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "distance = np.zeros((n_cities, n_cities))\n",
        "\n",
        "for i in range(n_cities):\n",
        "    for j in range(n_cities):\n",
        "        distance[i][j] = np.linalg.norm(\n",
        "            cities[i] - cities[j]\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def route_length(route):\n",
        "    total = 0\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i in range(len(route)):\n",
        "        total += distance[\n",
        "            route[i],\n",
        "            route[(i + 1) % len(route)]\n",
        "        ]\n",
        "\n",
        "    return total\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def PSO():\n",
        "\n",
        "    w = 0.7\n",
        "    c1 = 1.5\n",
        "    c2 = 1.5\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    position = np.random.rand(particles, n_cities)\n",
        "\n",
        "    velocity = np.random.uniform(\n",
        "        -0.1, 0.1, (particles, n_cities)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    def decode(x):\n",
        "        return np.argsort(x)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    pbest = position.copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    pbest_scores = np.array([\n",
        "        route_length(decode(x))\n",
        "        for x in position\n",
        "    ])\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    g_idx = np.argmin(pbest_scores)\n",
        "\n",
        "    gbest = pbest[g_idx].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    best_distance = pbest_scores[g_idx]\n",
        "\n",
        "    convergence = []\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "    for iteration in range(iterations):\n",
        "\n",
        "        for i in range(particles):\n",
        "\n",
        "            r1 = np.random.rand(n_cities)\n",
        "            r2 = np.random.rand(n_cities)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "            velocity[i] = (\n",
        "                w * velocity[i]\n",
        "                + c1 * r1 * (pbest[i] - position[i])\n",
        "                + c2 * r2 * (gbest - position[i])\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "            velocity[i] = np.clip(\n",
        "                velocity[i], -1, 1\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "            position[i] += velocity[i]\n",
        "\n",
        "            position[i] = np.clip(\n",
        "                position[i], -5, 5\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "            score = route_length(\n",
        "                decode(position[i])\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "            if score < pbest_scores[i]:\n",
        "\n",
        "                pbest[i] = position[i].copy()\n",
        "                pbest_scores[i] = score\n",
        "\n",
        "                if score < best_distance:\n",
        "\n",
        "                    best_distance = score\n",
        "                    gbest = position[i].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "        convergence.append(best_distance)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return decode(gbest), best_distance, convergence\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "best_route, best_distance, convergence = PSO()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Best Route:\", best_route)\n",
        "print(\"Best Distance:\", round(best_distance, 2))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
        "\n",
        "route = list(best_route) + [best_route[0]]\n",
        "\n",
        "route_cities = cities[route]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    route_cities[:, 0],\n",
        "    route_cities[:, 1],\n",
        "    'b-o',\n",
        "    linewidth=2,\n",
        "    markersize=6\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "for i, (x, y) in enumerate(cities):\n",
        "    plt.text(x + 1, y + 1, str(i))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Optimal TSP Route Using PSO\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"X Coordinate\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Y Coordinate\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    range(1, iterations + 1),\n",
        "    convergence,\n",
        "    color=\"red\",\n",
        "    linewidth=2\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"PSO Convergence Graph\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Number of Iterations\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Best Route Distance\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nPSO Execution Completed Successfully!\")\n"
      ]
    }
  ]
